title: A DOWNED TEAMMATE SHOWS DOWN AND [E] REVIVE
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid reads like a shooter HUD. Holding E beside a downed teammate picks him up, but nothing over him said so: a downed pillager got [E] REVIVE with his seconds, a teammate only his name. A downed teammate now shows DOWN and the seconds he has left over his head, in red, seen from anywhere on screen, and within reach he gets the same prompt as the pillager: [E] REVIVE and his name with his seconds. Nothing is drawn over yourself, and his bleed clock is only read.
now: A downed teammate shows DOWN with his seconds, and within reach [E] REVIVE with his name.
